instance.description: Predict the porosity category of one or more MOFs from linker SMILES and metal symbols, returned directly in the API response. Supports broadcasting: pass many linkers with one metal, one linker with many metals, or equal-length lists paired in order.

linkers.description: SMILES string(s) of the organic linker(s)

metals.description: Elemental symbol(s) of the metal(s), e.g. Zn, Cu, Fe

predictions.description: One prediction per (linker, metal) pair after broadcasting

linker.description: SMILES of the linker used for this prediction

metal.description: Metal symbol used for this prediction

pld_gt_2_4A.description: Model M1: pore limiting diameter predicted larger than 2.4 Å

pld_gt_4_4A.description: Model M2: pore limiting diameter predicted larger than 4.4 Å

pld_gt_5_9A.description: Model M3: pore limiting diameter predicted larger than 5.9 Å

category.description: Overall porosity category from the ensemble

dataset.description: Batch-predict MOF porosity from a CSV file of explicit linker,metal pairs (one MOF per row). Produces a downloadable CSV of predictions.

file.description: CSV with 'linker' and 'metal' columns, one MOF per row

predictions.csv.description: Input rows augmented with per-model predictions and the overall porosity category
